## What happened?

Please describe what you were doing and what you expected to happen.

## Diagnostic details

Paste the sanitized diagnostics supplied by AstroArchive, if available. Review the report and remove anything you do not want to share before submitting.

## Handling

If you want GitHub Copilot coding agent to investigate or propose a fix, assign this issue to Copilot after reviewing it. Do not include private images, archive contents, credentials, or other sensitive data.
